maria-peopleops: Heads-up: small leadership tweak + a pair of backfills approved for Runtime this quarter. Posting quick summary here so hiring teams can act.

kevin-cto: Thanks Maria. This keeps momentum on a few infra projects — appreciate the quick turnaround from Finance. :rocket:

maria-peopleops: Summary: 2 backfills (Senior Infra Engineer, Runtime PM), plus conversion of one long-term contractor to FTE (inference infra). No other headcount changes. Effective next Tue.

tanya-ramos: Confirming I9ll take mentorship for the incoming infra hire; want to fold them into the canary + rollback workstreams.

sunil-patel: For the contractor->FTE conversion (Arthur), suggested ramp plan: 2-week shadowing with kernel team, then ownership of one profiling pipeline. Arthur9s ok with timeline.

jen-recruiter: I'll open a backfill req for Senior Infra Eng and Runtime PM now. ETA: initial screens in 2-3 weeks. Recruiting asks: hiring managers please add 2 panelists in Greenhouse by Friday.

olivia-ops: Quick ops note: please update runbook ownership in PagerDuty before conversions happen so escalation routes are accurate.

hr-bot: Reminder: add role descriptions to the calibration doc by 11:59pm PT Thu to avoid delays.

maria-peopleops: Action items: 1) Hiring managers add panelists in GH; 2) Ops update PD escalation; 3) People Ops will post welcome template for intros. We'll do a short "meet the new leads" Q&A next Wed 9am PT.

jen-recruiter: I'll share JD links + initial interview rubrics in #recruiting after I file reqs.

sunil-patel: One ask: can PM backfill have prior infra rollout experience? will note on req.

maria-peopleops: Noted. Thanks all, feel free to DM with any conflicts.
